1.note: Weiss's second quotation has בשפתים where the verse (and his own first quotation) has בשבועה; kept as he wrote it.

2.note: Last word unclear in the scan (OCR שתרם); read שערם, an echo of Deut. 32:17 ‘whom your fathers knew not’.

3.note: So printed. The words 'כך דרשתי וכך דרשו חברי' stand in Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:2 (10:2 in some editions).

4.note: So printed. The great court deciding is in Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:2 (10:2 in some editions).

5.note: Logical terms נושא/נשוא (subject/predicate); 'subject' = the Scribes who make the inferences, 'object' = the Torah inferred from.

6.note: Print reads קלס, 'praised'; OCR had קלם.

7.note: Literally 'and they fed him by his hand'; read with the Tosefta as: they made Shammai feed the child with his own hand (see note 1 on this page).

8.note: Printed spelling טהיאפיל; rendered as the usual name Theophilus.

9.note: The question mark after the page number is printed so in the original.

10.note: Printed 20b (colon); the story of Hillel's burnt-offering begins on Betzah 20a. Kept as printed.

11.note: The mishnah 'Ten genealogical classes came up from Babylonia' (Kiddushin 4:1) stands at Kiddushin 69a; kept as printed.

12.note: Read as kelal u-ferat u-khelal (one middah); could also be meant as two items, ‘kelal u-ferat’ and ‘kelal’.

13.note: The print looks like והרב"ד; read as הראב"ד, to whom the commentary on the Baraita of R. Ishmael (in the Sifra) is ascribed.

14.note: Unclear abbreviation in the print; taken as ‘or the reading’. The closing parenthesis is missing in the print.

15.note: Print unclear (OCR ומה"ע); read ומר"ע, since the saying about every tittle is told of R. Akiva (Menaḥot 29b).

16.note: ‘The periodical of R. A. G.’, probably Abraham Geiger's journal, vol. 5.

17.note: The folio letter is faint; read ג (Shabbat 3a, where Tosafot discuss בעשותה). OCR had נ.

18.note: So printed; the Bavli passage defining midrash is at Kiddushin 49b.

19.note: Reading נגד is from the print; sense: contrary to the Talmud's usage, which calls all such learning midrash.

20.note: So printed (ה' = fifth); the sense requires ח', the eighth.

22.note: So printed (אומר); Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:9 has אוסר, 'forbids', which the sense requires.

23.note: So printed; the words מוסרני לכם are in Mishnah Shevi'it 10:4, discussed at Gittin 36a–b.

24.note: Literally 'so as not to give the Sadducees [occasion] to rule/subdue'; rendered 'a hold'.

25.note: The mishnah number is blurred in the scan; read as 1:5, where the court of priests is named.

26.note: The court of priests is in Rosh Hashanah 1:7; kept as printed.
